# VEYGO

> VEYGO (veygoapp.com) is a free live map of vendors whose spot moves: food trucks, taco stands, carts, dessert and coffee trucks, market and pop-up sellers, and mobile services. Vendors post where they're set up and for how long, and their pins move when they do. VEYGO stands for Vendors Everywhere You Go. Mission: every vendor found, every customer fed.

## For customers
- [Live map](https://veygoapp.com/?map=1): see which vendors are open near you right now. Free, no account needed to browse.
- Tap a pin to see today's spot, menu, photos and hours, and get directions.
- [Spin the wheel](https://veygoapp.com/spin): can't decide what to eat? It picks from the food vendors open near you.
- [Popular searches](https://veygoapp.com/find/): pages for searches like "food trucks near me open now", "taco truck near me", "tamales near me" and "mobile car detailing near me".
- [Food trucks by city](https://veygoapp.com/food-trucks/): a page for each of more than 140 cities, listing the vendors live near that city.
- VEYGO is new, so some areas are still filling in. It started in Stockton, California, and works in any city.

## For vendors
- [How it works for vendors](https://veygoapp.com/vendors): your own page, a live pin that follows you, and customers who follow you. For food trucks, carts, stands, markets, pop-ups and mobile services.
- [Join](https://veygoapp.com/join): $29 a month or $290 a year, no set-up fee, cancel any time. Each extra truck, cart or location is $15 a month.
- Beta offer: the first 25 vendors get 3 months free with code BETA.
- [Printable window stickers, flyers and handouts](https://veygoapp.com/downloads), the [vendor flyer](https://veygoapp.com/flyer/) and the [window sticker](https://veygoapp.com/sticker/).

## For creators and reviewers
- [Creator and affiliate program](https://veygoapp.com/affiliates): get a code and a link, and earn 20% of everything each vendor you bring in pays during their first year.

## The apps
- [Get VEYGO](https://veygoapp.com/app): the website works on any phone today. The Android app is in its Google Play test, and anyone with an Android phone can join as a founding tester. The iPhone app is not out yet; there is a waitlist.

## For local businesses
- [Advertise](https://veygoapp.com/advertise): a week in the Sponsored banner above the map. Every ad is reviewed before it goes live.

## Events and catering
- VEYGO does not take bookings. People planning an event can find local vendors on the map and contact them directly from their page.
